digest.component_or_area: plan review gate / CLI and MCP frontends
propositions: The CLI implements a classifier that discriminates passed-but-unsigned (retryable) from other plan review outcomes, but this logic exists only in _cli/_llm_commands.py and is not shared with _mcp_llm.py
MCP agents receive verdict: PASS for unsigned reviews without indication the signature failed to persist, causing them to proceed to claim gate which then rejects the missing signature
The sign_review recovery function is already exposed over MCP but agents are not informed to invoke it when a review passes without valid attestation
The CLI maps the retryable state to exit 11 with specific stderr, and this behavior must be preserved after extracting the classifier
The passed-but-unsigned state must be detectable and recoverable through both CLI and MCP surfaces with consistent semantics
